title: Field and density changes are recorded only after they save
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. You can open Google Analytics for the property the QA build reports to, at Admin > DebugView. The QA build runs analytics in debug mode, so each event appears in DebugView within a few seconds under your user. If you cannot open DebugView, the event checks in this case cannot be done by hand: write "not checked by hand" in the result comment and pass or fail on what you can see on the Work Orders page.
  5. Event names to look for in DebugView: work_orders_display_view (a display was shown), work_orders_field_load and work_orders_density_load (the fields and density you have, once per display per session), work_orders_field_toggle and work_orders_density_change (a saved change).
  6. Start a fresh analytics session: close every browser window, open a new private window and sign in.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders and click Board View.
  2. Open Fields to display, turn Service advisor on and Customer off, then close the picker.
  3. In DebugView, count the work_orders_field_toggle events.
  4. Open the density control (Density in the PRD. The design shows "Card size") and pick Compact.
  5. Count the work_orders_density_change events.
  6. Open the density control again and pick Compact again (the value it already has).
  7. Open Fields to display and close it without changing anything.
  8. Count the change events since step 5.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: 2 field change events, one for Service advisor (on) and one for Customer (off).
  • Step 5: 1 density change event, naming Compact.
  • Step 8: 0 new events. Re-picking the same density and closing the picker without a change are not changes.
  • A failed save cannot be caused by hand without also blocking analytics. That part is not checked by hand: write "failed save: not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10593 (Story 12, Google Analytics for display and field usage); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S12-R3, S12-R8, S12-R9, read 8 Oct 2026. Event names and timing: SV-10593 comments by Slavcho Mitrov and Milos Vasic, 6 Oct 2026 (the agreed GA4 event table); earlier event contract on Review Decisions page 853901313 (29 Sep 2026) uses older names.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R3: “Measure field-selection changes after successful saves.”
  • S12-R8: “Measure density changes after successful saves.”
  • S12-R9: “Do not count canceled or failed saves as successful preference changes.”
